title: Duties of the Parties
author: Example Publisher
text: Each Party has certain duties under this Agreement:

sections.title: Good Faith
sections.text: Each Party shall behave honestly and with integrity.

sections.title: Notice of Default
sections.text: A Party finding the other in Default shall give written notice, which the other Party may cure under <ref:cure>.

sections.title: Cure of Default
sections.text: A Party receiving notice under shall make a good faith effort to cure within 10 days.
An untitled paragraph following the titled sections.
